name: Sierra Stillwater
source:
Sierra Stillwater is the Lone River P&P's secretary. After graduating high school, she took the position to be closer to her [url=https://vndb.org/c167448]uncle[/url] whom she did not get to see much growing up. Loyal to a fault, Sierra never walks away from her friends and loved ones when they need her the most.
